citations.text: Daniel S. Himmelstein, Antoine Lizee, Christopher Hessler, Lev Braverman, Duncan Briscoe, Stephen A. Ramsey, Casey S. Greene (2017). Systematic Integration of Biomedical Knowledge Prioritizes Drugs for Repurposing. bioRxiv.

description: Heterogeneous biomedical knowledge graph integrating 29 public databases. Contains 11 node types (Compounds, Diseases, Genes, Proteins, etc.) connected by 24 edge types including compound-disease treatments, gene-disease associations, and protein interactions. Designed for drug repurposing and biomedical discovery.
